messages:
Devin: Heads up — saw a billing spike from dedicated-gpu-uswest this morning, ~2.8x our usual. Top line shows a bunch of highmem-gpu instances launched.
Maria: Do you have the dashboard link / rough $$ delta?
Devin: Cost dashboard: https://billing.internal/reports/1942 — total +$29k/day vs baseline ~$11k. Pool 'ded-gpu-heavy' shows 45 highmem-gpu-v2 nodes up.
Priya: That pool is autoscaled for batch-inference. Config should be standard-gpu-v2, not highmem. Anyone change the node template?
Jules: I merged a terraform tweak last night (PR #834) to add memoryOptimized=true for a different job. Possible var collision across modules.
Devin: Here's the diff I pulled from the state to help debug:
```
- instance_type = "standard-gpu-v2"
+ instance_type = "highmem-gpu-v2"
resource "redwood_node_pool" "ded-gpu-heavy" {
  count = 45 -> 45
}
```
Maria: Yikes. Does the autoscaler pick instance type from the pool template or pick any compatible family during provisioning?
Priya: Our provisioner prefers node_selector.family = preferred, but fallback policy is `pick-any-compatible`. Looks like the fallback matched highmem since it had the right accelerator profile.
SRE Oncall: Can we scale that pool down safely? We should stop more highmem nodes from launching and drain the ones that are up.
Devin: I'll disable autoscale for ded-gpu-heavy and start draining the highmem nodes. Opening a billing ticket with cloud: TKT-5621. Running:
```
./infractl pools set-autoscale ded-gpu-heavy --min 0 --max 0
./infractl nodes drain --label pool=ded-gpu-heavy --filter instance_type=highmem-gpu-v2
```
Jules: Sorry team — my var rename in main.tf accidentally propagated to the shared module. Reverting the PR now and pushing a hotfix.
Maria: Action items: Jules revert + run terraform plan; Devin verify node template and force a replace where needed; Priya audit fallback policy so autoscaler won't pick wrong families; tag excess nodes with billing-investigation=1942002468 so FinOps can filter.
CostBot: Cost anomaly detected: +$18,300 unplanned in us-west-2. Linked invoice: https://billing.internal/invoice/INV-2026-1933 :eyes:
Priya: Also check commitments/reserved capacity coverage — these highmem nodes are non-committed so hit list price and blow out unit economics.
Devin: Agreed. I'll add a runbook note, set a hard cap on highmem family in the autoscaler config, and request a credits review from cloud support for the provisioning mistake. Will post updates here.
Maria: :thumbsup: If scale-down doesn't finish in 10m, escalate to cloud support and ping me. Thanks everyone.
